about.title: Behind the Art
about.introBody: Drawing is my favorite way to give shape to odd little ideas, expressive characters, and everyday moments. Rather than sticking to a single rigid style, I like jumping between clean digital illustration, tiny pixel sprites, loose sketches, and playful visual experiments.
about.approachBody: Playful, character-driven, and curiosity-first. Some pieces are polished character posters; others start as quick red-ink doodles or mixed-media jokes with real photos.
about.mascotCardNote: Original heart-hands mascot preserved as brand centerpiece.
